caption: The drawing depicts a large stoneware jug with a narrow neck and small mouth, featuring a short, slightly flared lip. The jug has a rounded, bulbous body tapering towards the top. Its surface is a light brownish-gray color, with blue decorative elements including two wavy horizontal bands, one near the top and another below the center, and additional blue accents at the base. The jug prominently displays blue stenciled text reading “J. HAMILTON & CO. GREENSBORO, PA” and “2 2 2” in large, bold numbers in the center. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a separate smaller sketch of the jug’s neck and handle, colored similarly in light brown-gray with blue accents. The drawing is set within a rectangular border on a beige background.
title: Jug
